qs.ours: Cicero thus addresses Ccesar: *"* We have heard ^ou say that we reckon all those our enemies, except those who are with us; but that you reckon all those your friends who are not against you.—Nos omnes adversarios putare nisi qui nobiscum essent: te omnes qui contra te non essenty tuos."—*OrcU. pro Ligaiio^ adjinem.*
